environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between NLB and application. SQLite database file at /var/lib/app/users.db with default permissions. Application runs as ec2-user. No request filtering or inspection at any layer.
